curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Vincent barely passed the bar after six attempts and has never tried a case, leaving his innocent kin in the hands of sheer instinct.
curatedMovie.description: Wrongfully arrested for murder in rural Alabama, two college pals call in their only legal hope: Brooklyn cousin Vincent Gambini, a newly minted lawyer arriving with his sharp girlfriend to take on his very first trial.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A funny, medium-paced legal comedy blending Southern courtroom procedure with lively cultural friction and moderate dramatic stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Jonathan Lynn's comedy balances real courtroom stakes with irresistible culture-clash humor, turning a novice defense into an engaging clash of Southern order and Brooklyn swagger.
